comment: Recognition layer 2 — community and district signs. Route order: Norman Manley Airport → Palisadoes → Harbour View → Kingston → Half Way Tree → Spanish Town → Bog Walk → Linstead → Moneague → Faith's Pen → Fern Gully → Ocho Rios. Coordinates are real-world lat/lon projected to world space via road.project() at runtime. radius = trigger distance in compressed-world units (scale 0.3, so 100 world units ≈ 333 m real). needs_owner_review: true marks any entry where OSM/research data may differ from the owner's lived knowledge — the owner's knowledge is authoritative.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The narrow sand spit connecting Norman Manley Airport to Kingston — sea on both sides; Gun Boat Beach is on the harbour side

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Eastern gateway into Kingston at the foot of the Palisadoes roundabout; potholes begin just past here (government keeps the airport road pristine)

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Named for the 17th-century fortress walls; Rockfort Mineral Bath is a Kingston institution along Windward Road

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hillside community overlooking eastern Kingston; birthplace of Jamaican jazz and Rastafarian culture

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Eastern Kingston community along Mountain View Avenue — close to the National Stadium

communities.name: Franklin Town
communities.note: Eastern Kingston community along the Mountain View/Windward Road corridor

communities.name: Kingston
communities.note: Capital and largest city of Jamaica — founded 1692 after the earthquake destroyed Port Royal

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major Kingston intersection — the 'town square' of south Kingston

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's financial and hotel district — modern high-rises, embassies, and Emancipation Park

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The beating heart of uptown Kingston — named for a cotton tree that stood halfway between Kingston and Spanish Town

communities.name: Hagley Park
communities.note: West Kingston community along Hagley Park Road, heading toward Spanish Town

communities.name: Trench Town
communities.note: Birthplace of reggae and ska — home of Bob Marley, the Wailers, and Toots and the Maytals

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's first capital, founded by the Spanish in 1534 — Cathedral, courthouse, and the famous Spanish Town Square

communities.name: Twickenham Park
communities.note: St. Catherine community on the road north toward Bog Walk

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Small St. Catherine community just before the Bog Walk gorge entrance

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the Bog Walk gorge — the dramatic Rio Cobre canyon with Flat Bridge at its heart

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: St. Catherine market town — immortalised in the folk song 'Linstead Market': Carry mi ackee go a Linstead market…

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Hill-country junction at ~450 m elevation — the famous Moneague Lake is a sinkhole that fills seasonally

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: The legendary hilltop cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival, and the best views north

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: A lush 3 km canyon road canopied by hundreds of fern species — one of Jamaica's most iconic drives

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: St. Ann's Bay cruise-ship town — home of Dunn's River Falls, journey's end
